name: kr300_three_stage_frozen_cascade_ablation_v1
created: 2026-10-25 (Asia/Shanghai), before any stage-2/3 result was computed
user_additions_before_freeze: Window low-speed variant (W=30 past steps, numpy MLP) added by user before freeze; included here, no results seen.
task: pure inverse dynamics; no stage receives measured torque history (tau_meas is only a training target)
data: /workspace/kr300-identification/filtered_causal.npz (10 Hz, causal 2 Hz Butterworth, motor-side torque)

split.test: recording 12 (22H_58M), descriptive only, never used for any choice
split.cv: 5-fold grouped by recording: fold0={0,1,2}, fold1={3,4}, fold2={5,6}, fold3={7,8}, fold4={9,10} held out

stage1.model: repo delivered physics: identify.py alternating bounded LS (10 iters, FISTA 1500) -> psd_constrained FISTA 800 iters with r_pre fixed -> bounded fric/hyd refit -> J1 posthoc d (LS)
stage1.cv: refit per fold on fold-train recordings only; final test model refit on all 11 recordings (reproduces repo numbers)
stage1.phi: per joint: inertia r*Y(q,0,qdd)pi (+d*qdd1 on J1), coriolis r*(Y(q,qd,0)-Y(q,0,0))pi, gravity r*Y(q,0,0)pi, friction, hydraulic(J2; 0 elsewhere) -> 30 features
stage1.z: q(6), qd(6), qdd(6), tau1(6), phi(30) = 54 dims, standardised with fold-train stats

masks.slow: max_j|qd_j| < 0.05 rad/s (threshold pre-set in repo stage1_motion.py from training data) for run length >= 10 samples (1 s); shorter runs count as motion
masks.dwell: slow runs with length >= 30 samples (3 s), subset of slow

stage2_Fmot.arch: GRU 1 layer hidden 32, input z, linear head 6 -> r2; h2 = GRU hidden (32)
stage2_Fmot.loss: MSE on motion samples only (standardised per-joint target scale)
stage2_Fmot.train: Adam lr 1e-3, full batch of whole training trajectories, 300 epochs fixed, no early stopping, grad clip 1.0
stage2_Fmot.inference: runs over whole trajectory, then frozen

stage3_GRU.arch: GRU 1 layer hidden 32 + linear head 6 (same for G2 and G4)
stage3_GRU.train: identical to stage2: Adam 1e-3, 300 epochs, no early stop, clip 1.0

stage3_Window.model: numpy MLP 1 hidden layer 64 tanh, linear out 6
stage3_Window.train: Adam lr 1e-3, full batch, 1000 epochs fixed, no early stop, weight init N(0,1/fan_in)

output: tau = tau2 + m_slow * r3 (G4); tau1 + m_slow * r3 (G2); G3 = tau2; G1 = tau1
metrics: RMSE per joint (Nm) and macro = mean over 6 joints; strata overall/motion/slow/dwell; per fold (seed mean) and CV = mean over folds; seed range reported
criterion: separately for GRU and Window: stage 2 useful for stage 3 iff G4 < G2 in macro overall RMSE in all 5 folds (seed-mean) AND mean paired diff G4-G2 < 0
no_tuning: no hyperparameter search, all groups reported
